subject: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Chen <eliot.chen@atlaslabs.com>, procurement@atlaslabs.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing

Hi Eliot / Atlas procurement team,

Thanks again for confirming the renewal and the additional GPU capacity — excited to have Atlas Labs expanding with Redwood. To keep bookkeeping smooth across the move to your EU entity, proposed plan below: 

- Effective with the new term (start 2029-06-01), invoices will be issued to Atlas Labs S.A.R.L. (France) for EU usage and to Atlas Labs, Inc. (US) for any US-billed pockets.
- We request a signed PO that references RDW-Deal ATL-2029-RNWL-47 by 2029-05-17 to ensure billing cutover on the first invoice.
- Default net terms for renewals are Net45; if procurement needs Net30 for the first invoice window we can accommodate a one-time Net30 for this renewal but will require PO + signed amendment.
- Please send the PO to billing@redwood.com and include the payor entity name you want on the invoices.

Can you confirm: who will sign the PO (Eliot vs Marie), and whether Atlas Procurement needs any additional vendor docs (W-9/W-8/W-9 equivalent or EU VAT certificate)? I attached Redwood W-9 for your treasury team.

If helpful, Priya (AM) and Lauren (Finance) are looped for quick decisions on invoice sequencing and tax evidence.

Thanks,

— Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
sergio@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Attachment: redwood_w9_2024.pdf (pdf, 148 KB)

From: Eliot Chen <eliot.chen@atlaslabs.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, procurement@atlaslabs.com
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing

Hi Sergio — appreciate the clear plan. A couple of clarifying points from procurement: 

1) Atlas EU (Marie Dupont) will be the invoiced entity for EU-hosted usage; US R&D spend will remain on Atlas US. We'll confirm the exact legal names in the PO.
2) For payment terms: procurement prefers Net30 as a standard. Would Redwood accept Net30 for this renewal as a one-time exception?
3) Our procurement checklist requires proof of tax registration for vendors and a completed supplier onboarding PDF (attached). Please confirm where in the invoice header we should expect the PO number.

I can sign the PO for the US side; Marie will sign the EU PO. We'll aim to get the PO back by 2029-05-14 but may need until 2029-05-17 depending on internal approvals.

Thanks,
Eliot
Eliot Chen
Procurement Lead, Atlas Labs
procurement@atlaslabs.com
Attachment: Atlas_procurement_requirements.pdf (docx, 82 KB)

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing

Lauren / Priya — forwarding Eliot's note. Procurement is asking for Net30 as a one-time for this renewal; they expect to deliver two POs (US and EU) and target 2029-05-14 but may slip to 05-17.

Questions: can finance accept a one-off Net30 for ATL-2029-RNWL-47? If yes, any contract amendment needed or is a signed PO sufficient? Also procurement wants vendor tax registration evidence for the EU billing path — do we have a VAT registration or equivalent docs for the Redwood EU payor (or do we need to provide a tax agent contact)?

I'm prepping the amendment link if needed.

— Sergio

> > Attachment: Atlas_procurement_requirements.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing

Thanks for the context. Finance can approve a one-time Net30 for the upcoming invoice cycle under these conditions: 

- We receive a signed PO that references RDW-Deal ATL-2029-RNWL-47 and explicitly states Net30 on the PO header.
- EU invoices will require either Atlas' VAT number or we will invoice the EU entity net of VAT as agreed — please have Marie confirm VAT ID so we can populate the invoice.
- Send the signed PO to billing@redwood.com; finance will issue the first invoice on 2029-06-01 and set payment due 30 days after invoice date.
- If we do Net30 for this renewal, future renewals will default back to Net45 per our terms unless a new amendment is agreed.

I've attached the internal invoice instructions we share with procurement teams. Priya, please coordinate the DocuSign amendment if Eliot wants the one-time Net30 locked in contractually; otherwise the PO + signed cover note is acceptable for billing.

— Lauren Bishop
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: invoice_instructions.md

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
To: Eliot Chen <eliot.chen@atlaslabs.com>, Marie Dupont <m.dupont@atlaslabs.fr>, procurement@atlaslabs.com
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 May 2029 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement migration: billing cutover plan and PO sequencing

Eliot / Marie — thank you. Confirming next steps and timeline: 

1) Atlas to return two signed POs (US + EU) that include the PO reference RDW-Deal ATL-2029-RNWL-47, ideally by 2029-05-14 but no later than 2029-05-17. Send to billing@redwood.com. Attachment sample: Atlas_PO_12345.pdf.
2) Redwood accepts Net30 for the first invoice for this renewal only; finance (Lauren) will revert to Net45 on subsequent renewals unless a new amendment is executed.
3) Marie — please reply with the Atlas EU VAT ID (or instruct us to invoice without VAT if that is your preference).
4) Priya will send a DocuSign amendment link if you'd like the Net30 exception recorded in the contract; otherwise the PO + email confirmation will be the operational trigger.

I'll mark the HubSpot opportunity as "billing pending PO" and follow up on 2029-05-16 for status. Thanks again — we'll hold the cutover pending receipt of the PO(s).

Best,
Sergio Alvarez
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Attachment: Atlas_PO_12345.pdf (pdf, 56 KB)
